rest.note: the defaults; restMeasured is what the feed says

restMeasured.computed: from baseline.json and demand.json, 253 timed lines, 513,266 commuters in the fit, 2026-08-31

sources.noCar: set from memory; 0.4 cars per household (O&S, early 2023); check against CBS maatwerk 2026/15, addresses by number of cars (notes/cities/amsterdam.md)
sources.twoWheelShare: tuned: one trip in three by bicycle (O&S 2022), 56 per cent of commutes (2024)
sources.car: ANWB running cost about €0.25/km (estimate); parking €7.50 an hour in the centre and €1.40 to €6 elsewhere (Gemeente Amsterdam tariffs), so about €3 a trip averaged over free and paid (estimate); five minutes to park (estimate)
sources.votSPerEur: half the Dutch median wage of about €24 gross an hour (CBS 2025) is €12, 300 s a euro

timetables.text: GVB and NS timetables from the Dutch open transit data (OVapi / NDOV)

signs.note: GVB: metro 50–54, trams from 1, buses from 15, numbers on a square
